fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (no owner present) for change set 01M75RDBYXWSMQM0YPEQQ4ECY3. The change set's intent already carries the owner's request and scope, quoted there from 2026-11-11: copy Nebari's bug dispatch (nebari PR #94) into this repo, minus the GitHub issue intake. The planner read Nebari's .rhiza/dispatch.toml, plan-bug.toml and bugfix.toml, this repo's .rhiza/workflows (docs.toml, ship.sh; no ship-change override, no dispatch.toml), docs/runs-and-daemon.md and docs/custom-workflows.md (which already document dispatch in general). Assumptions taken without escalation: the change set serves m4-orchestrated-by-rhiza, as recent fixes to Rhiza's own runs serve milestone 4's intents; the config is one leaf (dispatch.toml and both workflows together, since dispatch naming missing workflows is broken); the docs note goes in CLAUDE.md, the repo's contributor and agent guidance, because the product docs already explain dispatch and this note is about this repo only. No questions parked.
fields.title: Autonomous plan of Rhiza's own bug workflows
